changelog:
v1.3.1 — Emoji size + text-default emoji fix
• Fixed shrunk emoji: the macOS 26 CBDT build labeled strike ppem as the bitmap pixel size, dropping Apple's ~1.17em overshoot. Strike ppem is now scaled (17/22/27/34/41/45/55/82) so emoji render at the natural v1.1.0 size.
• Restored cmap format-14 (371 VS16 sequences) that the macOS 26 build dropped, so ❤️ ☹️ ♾️ and other text-default emoji resolve to Apple instead of the stock legacy font.
• Restored the fonts.xml emoji-family promotion for apps that parse fonts.xml.
• No bitmap data was modified.
